Edinburgh AI startup Quicksilver closes £3.2m Series A for geospatial models

Quicksilver, an Edinburgh AI company, has closed a £3.2 million Series A round to commercialise its geospatial data models.

The startup's software predicts flood risk from satellite imagery and is already used by two UK water companies.

Quicksilver was founded in 2022 by a team from the University of Edinburgh and employs 18 people, most of them in Scotland.
